body-aura.title: The Aura bodysuit
body-aura.tagline: Black lace sequinned with gold, black draping knotted at the bust.
description: Aura rests on a contrast. The black lace, scattered with gold sequins, catches the light at the slightest movement; a black drape, knotted at the bust, holds it in.
The sleeves are long, the neck is round. The body is covered in lace, and yet everything is hinted at.
details: Black draping knotted at the bust
care: [À COMPLÉTER : conseils d’entretien du body Aura]
body-aura.fit: A close-fitting bodysuit with long sleeves. To choose your size, rely on the size guide. The Maison will gladly advise you before you order.

robe-odessa.title: The Odessa dress
robe-odessa.tagline: A black bustier, a waist of floral lace, a long line that follows the body.
description: Odessa begins with a black bustier, held by two straps. At the waist, the floral lace takes over and lets the skin show between its motifs.
The dress falls long, close to the body. The solid black of the bustier, the transparency of the lace: strength and delicacy in the same line.
details: Long dress, close to the body
care: [À COMPLÉTER : conseils d’entretien de la robe Odessa]
robe-odessa.fit: A long dress, close to the body. To choose your size, rely on the size guide. The Maison will gladly advise you before you order.

robe-aria.title: The Aria dress
robe-aria.tagline: Lace above, satin below, and a gold ring to hold them together.
description: Aria reads in two movements. Above, black lace, sleeveless, crossed by a gathered drape that a gold ring holds in place.
Below, gathered black satin opens into a mermaid skirt. The dress is long; the gold sits at a single point, and that is where the eye comes to rest.
details: Gathered drape held by a gold ring
Mermaid skirt in gathered black satin
care: [À COMPLÉTER : conseils d’entretien de la robe Aria]
robe-aria.fit: A long dress, fitted down to the flare of the mermaid skirt. To choose your size, rely on the size guide. The Maison will gladly advise you before you order.

robe-sienna.title: The Sienna dress
robe-sienna.tagline: A high neck, a bare back, a bodice of black and gold lace.
description: Sienna closes high at the neck and leaves the back bare. The bodice is in black and gold lace; at the waist, gathers descend to a point.
Then black jersey takes over, down to the hem of the dress. A silhouette sculpted in front, free at the back.
details: Bodice in black and gold lace
care: [À COMPLÉTER : conseils d’entretien de la robe Sienna]
robe-sienna.fit: A long dress with a high neck and a bare back, the waist defined. To choose your size, rely on the size guide. The Maison will gladly advise you before you order.

body-gaia.title: The Gaïa bodysuit
body-gaia.tagline: A black bodysuit, and the lace that crosses it on the bias.
description: Gaïa is black, with long sleeves and a boat neck that frees the line of the shoulders.
Two bands of floral lace cross it on the bias, one at the shoulder, the other at the waist. They draw the silhouette in a single stroke.
details: Bands of floral lace on the bias, at the shoulder and at the waist

top-evina.tagline: A white top, a deep V neck, full sleeves.
description: Evina is the light piece of the collection. A white top, with a deep V neck and full sleeves.
At the waist, gathers draw the line in; higher up, the sleeves keep all their volume. Softness, this time, is on the side of white.

hypnotic-lace.title: Hypnotic Lace
intention: Delicacy meets strength. Elegance becomes a signature. A meeting between the finesse of lace, the sensuality of draping and the daring brilliance of gilding.
Through sculptural silhouettes and precious details, the “Hypnotic Lace” collection celebrates a femininity of contrasts: delicate, sensual and bold.
